payload AS (
  SELECT
    s.* EXCEPT(j),
    CASE
      WHEN JSON_VALUE(s.j, '$.all_imprints') IS NOT NULL
           AND SAFE.PARSE_JSON(JSON_VALUE(s.j, '$.all_imprints')) IS NOT NULL
